items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for any Woot rights-dependent, public-display, affiliate, advertising, or alert-expansion decision. Keep searchwoot.com private and keep rights outreach unsent. Evidence: Woot API access is documented, but redistribution, storage, derivatives, caching, public display, alerts, trademark/image/price use, affiliate use, and advertising rights are not evidenced; public terms restrict relevant uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, privacy, vendor, incident, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only when it preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering rights, data flow and retention, logs/vendors/incidents, consent and GA4 settings, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed; all 4 remain open. Existing API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts are partial evidence only. Do not close tasks without evidence. Keep the private gate unchanged and do not send external rights outreach pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing current written permission/API agreement, field-level rights, retention, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms/DPA review, incident handling, and request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory and route counsel-required gaps.

Fleet compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics quality is yellow because source permissions or collector results are unavailable; do not treat unavailable data as zero. Revenue is partial aggregate attribution: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, with the aggregate commission not assignable to a site. These gaps do not independently block ordinary bounded growth, but they block unsupported claims and rights-dependent monetization.
